metadata.redis_status: NOT_RUNNING_LOCALLY (Missing redis-py dependency; evaluated via DiskDurableQueueBroker test adapter)

commands.claim: XREADGROUP GROUP workers <worker_id> COUNT 1 BLOCK 2000 STREAMS yorvyn:stream:jobs >

reliability_properties.persistence: AOF (appendfsync everysec) + RDB snapshots every 5 minutes
reliability_properties.clustering: Redis Sentinel or AWS ElastiCache Multi-AZ with Automatic Failover
reliability_properties.backpressure: MAXLEN ~ 10000 on XADD prevents unbounded RAM growth

tests.name: Durable Job Enqueueing
tests.description: Verify job is atomically persisted in queue/incoming

tests.name: Bounded Queue Capacity & Backpressure
tests.description: Verify queue capacity limit (5) triggers backpressure exception on overflow

tests.name: Per-User Active Concurrency Limit
tests.description: Verify user attempting > 2 active queue slots receives ConcurrencyLimitExceededException

tests.name: Atomic Worker Claim & Mutual Exclusion
tests.description: Verify only one worker claims incoming job; second worker receives None

tests.name: Durable Completion Acknowledgement
tests.description: Verify job is purged from claimed queue only upon verified completion acknowledgement

tests.name: Worker Crash Recovery via Expired Lease Sweep
tests.description: Verify supervisor sweeps dead worker claims and restores them to incoming queue
